# Oxford English Dictionary

> The Oxford English Dictionary is the definitive historical record of the English language, documenting word meanings, etymologies, and usage across centuries with comprehensive entries, thesaurus organization, and multilingual borrowings.

The OED provides authoritative lexicographic information including detailed entry structures, pronunciation guides, historical word usage, and semantic categorization through its integrated Historical Thesaurus. It covers British English, U.S. English, and international English variants with etymological documentation of borrowed words from languages including Korean, French, Maltese, and Malay.

## Key Topics

- Etymology

## Core Resources

- [About the OED](https://www.oed.com/information/about-the-oed): Overview of Oxford English Dictionary's scope, history, and role as language authority
- [Historical Thesaurus - Start page](https://www.oed.com/thesaurus/start): Entry point for Historical Thesaurus word exploration and semantic categorization
- [Understanding entries](https://www.oed.com/information/understanding-entries): Guide to OED entry structure, abbreviations, symbols, and pronunciation conventions
